title: The CashDublo Newsletter begins
description: Short, plain-language news from the CashDublo workshop: new apps, new features and what's being built behind the scenes.
author: Greg Odom

title: Every app is getting a plain-words manual
description: Contracts and Wi-Fi Tether have customer-facing manuals. The same clear, self-service help standard is being extended across the app collection.
author: Greg Odom

title: Contracts adds a paper-vault workflow
description: Contracts is expanding beyond signing to help users keep important documents organized and easy to retrieve.
author: Greg Odom

title: Indy Travel adds hotel-price watching
description: A planned hotel-price monitoring feature lets users track a chosen property and receive an alert when its price changes.
author: Greg Odom

title: The CashDublo App Store gets its download engine
description: The store's download engine is designed to resume interrupted downloads instead of starting over.
author: Greg Odom

title: The CashDublo website becomes the main home
description: The website is the front door for the app collection, front ends and newsletter.
author: Greg Odom
